items.question: What makes Jawlah different?
items.answer: Unlike traditional delivery apps that focus on just one category, Jawlah combines multiple services into a single experience. You can order from restaurants, grocery stores, gas suppliers, and charities — all in one cart, with one checkout, and one tracking screen. We also prioritize Gulf-local design, bilingual support, and inclusive access for both customers and service providers.
